blocking_findings.reason: Final activity/toxicity rows are source-located but not field-level publication-grade. ACT-005 and ACT-006 set target_species to PseudomonasaeruginosaATCC 9027, and ACT-011 and ACT-012 set target_species to MRPACCARM 2095 instead of preserving Pseudomonas aeruginosa with strain/isolate ATCC 9027 or CCARM 2095. ACT-001 through ACT-012 omit Supplement Table S2 condition locators and record assay_volume as 50 uL, while the supplement MIC-test condition table gives bacterial cell number 2 x 10^4 CFU and total volume 100 uL. TOX-002 records hADMSC cytotoxicity lowest-effect concentration as exact 64 ug/mL, while the XML/PDF text and Figure 2 caption state decreased viability at concentrations above 64 ug/mL; the toxicity set also duplicates HaCaT and splits hADMSC into conflicting 64 and >64 records.
